body.text: DOJ let the deadline pass. At 12:01 this morning in Texas, a silencer changed hands with no federal registration for the first time since 1934.

DOJ did not appeal within Judge Hendrix's seven-day stay, so the NFA injunction took effect at midnight Central and GOA, Silencer Shop, Brandon Herrera and Rep. Wes Virdell completed two suppressor transfers with no Form 4. Critical caveat: missing the stay deadline is not declining to appeal — DOJ has roughly seven weeks left to file.

facts.title: 1. Silencer Shop v. ATF — stay lapsed, injunction live
2. Scope: 27 states clear, 15 still require registration
3. 47 GOP lawmakers ask DOJ to apply ruling nationwide

body.text:
• Stay lapsed without appeal — unregistered suppressor transfers done at 12:01am CT
• Silencer Shop's own caveats: 27 states clear, 15 not, SBR/SBS still need Form 4
• 9th Cir. reinstates injunction v. Hawaii private-property "vampire rule"
• Day 8 and no coverage peer has published a word on the NFA ruling
